specialRules.ruleFull: Only the Halfling Thief may take Stealthy.
The warband may hire any hired sword that human mercenaries may hire.
Halflings can never use a Long Bow, Elf Bow, Handgun, Long Rifle or Blunderbuss, even when an advance would let them.
Halflings get no bonus from Halfling items, such as the Halfling Cookbook.

cost.costSuffix: Halfling Elder and Halfling Scouts only
Halfling Elder and Halfling Scouts only

specialRules.ruleFull: Warriors within 6" of the Halfling Elder may take Leadership tests on his Leadership.
Roll a D6: on a 5+ the warband counts as one size smaller when it sells treasure or wyrdstone.

The Halfling Thief is set up after the enemy warband(s), anywhere on the table out of their sight and at least 12" from every enemy model. When more than one model can infiltrate, roll off to decide who places first.
To open a locked door the Halfling Thief needs only to pass an Initiative test.
If the Halfling Thief fought in the battle and was not taken out of action, the warband finds +1 treasure on top of its usual find.

fighters.name: Piggy
fighters.equipment: None. Piggies use no weapons and fight without penalty for it.

specialRules.ruleFull: Piggies are animals and never gain experience.
Any enemy may shoot at the Village Ogre, even when he is not the closest target.
If the Village Ogre becomes a Hero, he picks his skills from the Combat and Strength lists only.
The Village Ogre gains experience at half the usual rate.
While the warband has a Village Ogre no Ogre Bodyguard joins it, and one hired before the Village Ogre arrived leaves.

specialSkillsList.name: Quiet as a Mouse
specialSkillsList.description: While this Halfling is hidden, an enemy trying to spot him uses half his Initiative in inches, rounded down.

specialSkillsList.name: Crude Belch (Halflings MIC)
specialSkillsList.description: In the first round of a hand-to-hand combat the Halfling may belch over every enemy in base contact with him. Each must take a Leadership test, and one who fails misses his first attack, even if he has only one.

specialSkillsList.name: Wizened Halfling
specialSkillsList.description: Leader only. Halflings within 6" of him may re-roll a failed Leadership test, taking both the test and the re-roll on his Leadership.

specialSkillsList.name: Skilled Huntsman
specialSkillsList.description: When this Halfling shoots a missile weapon while hidden, roll a D6: on a 3+ he stays hidden that turn. Not with a black powder weapon.

specialSkillsList.name: Layers of Fat
specialSkillsList.description: The Halfling always has a basic 6+ save, whatever the attacker's Strength, on top of any armour he wears.

specialSkillsList.name: Shifty
specialSkillsList.description: When charged, the Halfling gains one bonus attack, which strikes first.

flags.what: The Adventurer list's names in brackets are the Halfling Cook's ("Halfling Cooks only"; William, 6 Nov 2026: "do we not add labels to his owning of those items? but yes all items that exist"): he buys from a list of his own, the Adventurer list with those five lines his. Three link our Halfling Cook items at the line's price: Tenderiser 3 gc, Cleaver shown as Meat Cleaver 5 gc, Cooking Pot Helmet shown as Cooking Pot 10 gc. We have no Pairing Knife or Machete, so those lines are the Dagger shown as Pairing Knife and the Sword shown as Machete. The other heroes keep the Adventurer list.

Our Cooking Pot Helmet gives a Master Chef an unmodified 5+ save against being stunned; the Helmet the PDF pairs it with gives 4+. Linked as it is. Our Tenderiser (stuns on 2-4) and Cleaver (-1 to the armour save) do what the Mace/Hammer and Axe do. Our items' own prices (Cleaver 3 gc, Cooking Pot Helmet 8 gc) are not the line's; the line's is used.
Hunting Arrows are 35 gc on the Adventurer list (the rulebook's are 25 gc): taken as printed.
The Halflings' Ogre maximum profile (M6 WS5 BS4 S6 T6 W4 I5 A4 Ld7) is unlike our Ogre race's, so the Village Ogre takes a new race, Ogre (Halflings), with it.
Henchmen group sizes are not given for the Halfling Scouts, Halfling Warriors or Piggies: left empty (no most per group). The Village Ogre's is 1, as there may be only one.
A Halfling warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.

The special skills differ from Mutiny in Marienburg's Halfling skills (Crude belch, Stealthy, Tea-leaf, Flan-eater, Looter, Taunt), now the Militant Mootlanders' group, which the Halflings don't learn from (William, 6 Nov 2026). Halflings (MIC) is their group; its Crude Belch is named apart from the Mootlanders' (theirs gives -1 to hit for the turn, not a lost first attack). Its Stealthy is the Mootlanders' Stealthy word for word in effect, so it links ours (William, 6 Nov 2026: "if the skills already exist word for word i dont care about the name but just keep the one variant"); the PDF heading's "Halfling Thieves Only" is a warband rule, Special Skills.
